# @wthek/hono-middleware

> Production-safe Hono error-handling middleware for `http-error-kit`.

## Overview
`@wthek/hono-middleware` catches `KitHttpError` and `KitGeneralError` instances thrown in Hono routes and automatically responds with the matching HTTP status code and structured JSON error payload. It integrates with Hono's `app.onError()`, supports custom logging functions, and provides optional fallback handling for unknown exceptions.

## Installation
```bash
npm install @wthek/hono-middleware http-error-kit http-response-status-code
```

## Quick Start
```typescript
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { KitHonoMiddleware } from "@wthek/hono-middleware";
import { BadRequestError, NotFoundError } from "http-error-kit";

const app = new Hono();

// Register global error handling middleware
KitHonoMiddleware(app, { log: true, handleUnknownErrors: true });

app.get("/api/users/:id", (c) => {
  const id = c.req.param("id");
  if (!id) {
    throw new BadRequestError("User ID is required");
  }
  throw new NotFoundError("User not found");
});

export default app;
```

## Scoped Error Handler (`KitHonoErrorHandler`)
```typescript
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { KitHonoErrorHandler } from "@wthek/hono-middleware";

const app = new Hono();

// Register directly via app.onError
app.onError(KitHonoErrorHandler({ log: true, handleUnknownErrors: true }));
```

## API Reference

### `KitHonoMiddleware(app: Hono, options?: IKitHonoMiddlewareOptions)`
Registers `KitHonoErrorHandler` on the given Hono instance via `app.onError()`.

### `KitHonoErrorHandler(options?: IKitHonoMiddlewareOptions)`
Returns a Hono-compatible error handler function: `(error: unknown, c: Context) => Response | Promise<Response>`.

#### Options (`IKitHonoMiddlewareOptions`)
- `log` (`boolean | ((error: unknown, c: Context) => void)`, default: `false`):
  When `true`, logs via `console.error`. When a function is provided, calls custom logger callback.
- `handleUnknownErrors` (`boolean`, default: `false`):
  When `true`, catches non-Kit errors and returns a structured 500 JSON response instead of plain text error message.

## Safety Rules for AI Agents
1. Register `KitHonoMiddleware(app)` during application setup before defining execution exports.
2. Throw errors directly from `http-error-kit` (e.g., `throw new NotFoundError(...)`) inside route handlers.
3. Hono automatically catches synchronous throws and rejected promises inside handlers and directs them to `onError`.
